text:
Rina K: FYI — SeaStack QBR prep. Overnight there was a sustained embeddings churn across 02:00-07:00 UTC, looks like ~2.7x baseline for several hours. Need a quick triage + cost scenarios for renewal deck.
Owen D: yep saw it. Spike concentrated on /v1/embeddings and the bulk-ingest worker. Possibly a backfill with no incremental flag.
Marco S: are they on credits or metered? that decides whether we push retainer or recommend auto-topup.
Rina K: credits with a nominal overage clause. Renewal in 6 weeks — avoid surprise asks.
Claire P: proposed next steps: 1) confirm exact job that caused churn 2) short 30-day forecast with persistent spike vs mitigated 3) recommend commercial + ops controls for QBR.
Owen D: pinged eng contact (ops@seastack.io)  they replied: "we ran a parallel reindex for a schema migration, forgot to toggle incremental."
Claire P: quick projection (very rough) pasted:
```
Baseline: 125k embed units/day
Spike: ~2.7x for ~4h -> extra ~210k units/night
30d baseline cost: $37,500
30d if repeat nightly: $60,300
Mitigated (cache + incremental + low-priority throttle): $40,100
Suggested safety: 1-month retainer or dynamic credit top-up (~$9k)
```
Marco S: two short mitigation motions for slides: A) Ops control: enforce incremental re-index by default + preflight gating for full re-syncs; B) Commercial: 1-month retainer or enable dynamic top-up that auto-applies credits at 85% to avoid renewal churn.
Rina K: add enablement ask: 25-min runbook with examples: "how to run incremental reindex", "embedding cache TTLs", and "preflight checklist for heavy jobs". Also capture feedback: onboarding quickstart doesn't clearly call out cost for resyncs — add an appendix.
Owen D: usage-bot can we create 75% soft alert + 92% hard alert for the current credit cycle and email AM + customer ops?
usage-bot: created alert: seastack-credits-75 (notify: customer-success@redwood, am@seastack.io), seastack-credits-92 (pager: oncall-billing). webhook -> #customer-success. thresholds set.
Claire P: for QBR slides i'll show a small waterfall (base / accidental / mitigated) and a delta table with per-1k embed unit cost and savings from recommended fixes.
Marco S: consider adding a short product suggestion for the roadmap: "cost-aware preflight warnings" that surface expected delta before heavy jobs run. Good upsell.
Rina K: owners: Owen = confirm exact job + timestamps; Marco = draft commercial language (retainer vs dynamic top-up + upsell copy); Claire = run numbers + slide; Rina = coordinate AM + schedule enablement.
Owen D: i'll follow up with ops@seastack.io and ask them to flip to incremental tonight.
Marco S: i'll size the retainer and draft a 1-paragraph value prop for renewal.
Claire P: i'll prepare the waterfall chart and include a tiny appendix of suggested runbook bullets.
Rina K: final ask: anyone can own follow-up with the AM to include the mitigation and commercial language in renewal notes before EOD?
Marco S: i'll own AM follow-up and confirm whether they accept a dynamic top-up pilot. Will update here. :thumbsup:
